name: Reflect
description_en:
Reflect now presents Reflect Open, a local Markdown note app with daily notes, wiki links and backlinks. Its official repository describes a folder-based graph that remains usable in other editors, with optional user-configured sync, AI and transcription services. Reflect Classic is a separate maintained product.

This distinction changes the price and deployment story: the current site says the Mac app is free, iPhone/iPad uses a paid subscription, and optional AI is billed by the provider using your own key. Do not carry Classic subscription assumptions into Open.
description_zh:
Reflect 当前主推 Reflect Open：使用本地 Markdown 文件、每日笔记、wiki 链接和反向链接的应用。官方仓库把资料库描述为其他编辑器也能使用的文件夹图谱，可选同步、AI 与转录服务由用户配置。Reflect Classic 是另一个仍维护的产品。

这一区分改变了费用与部署描述：当前官网说明 Mac 应用免费，iPhone／iPad 使用付费订阅，可选 AI 由用户自带密钥并向模型提供商付费。不能把 Classic 订阅条件套用到 Open。

core_features.explanation_en: Daily notes, wiki links, local search and backlinks over ordinary files.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在普通文件上提供每日笔记、wiki 链接、本地搜索与反向链接。

core_features.explanation_en: iCloud Drive or a user-controlled Git remote can sync/back up the graph.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可通过 iCloud Drive 或用户控制的 Git 远端同步／备份图谱。

core_features.explanation_en: Optional AI and transcription connect to configured providers with separate costs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可选 AI 与转录连接到配置的服务商，费用单独计算。

en: Capture daily notes linked to projects while retaining plain files.
zh: 在保留普通文件的同时记录关联项目的每日笔记。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Local app; optional direct user-configured services; beta and platform qualifications apply.
Deployment.zh: 本地应用，可选用户直接配置的服务；有 beta 与平台适用条件。

steps.en: Download the intended build and choose a graph folder.
steps.zh: 下载目标构建并选择图谱文件夹。

steps.en: Create a daily note and linked project note; inspect the Markdown on disk.
steps.zh: 创建每日笔记及关联项目笔记，检查磁盘 Markdown。

steps.en: Configure sync or AI only after checking its provider, cost and data path.
steps.zh: 核对提供商、费用及数据路径后，再配置同步或 AI。

items.en: The readme calls the product beta, prioritises Mac/iOS and excludes Android and a plugin API for now. The MIT licence permits source use under its notice terms; source builds require Rust, Node/pnpm and Apple tooling, unlike simply downloading an app. For a sync conflict, preserve both file versions and inspect history before overwriting anything. It fits file-owning personal note workflows; governed team co-editing, cross-platform production stability and guaranteed AI privacy require additional evidence. No build, key connection, migration or recovery was tested.
items.zh: README 将产品标为 beta，重点是 Mac／iOS，暂不覆盖 Android 和插件 API。MIT 许可按其声明条件允许使用源码；源码构建需要 Rust、Node／pnpm 和 Apple 工具，与直接下载应用不同。同步冲突时建议保留两个文件版本，覆盖前检查历史。它适合自行持有文件的个人笔记流程；受治理的团队共编、跨平台生产稳定性与 AI 隐私保证需要更多证据。未测试构建、密钥连接、迁移或恢复。

pricing.billing_basis: Free Mac; paid iOS store subscription; AI provider usage separate.

sections.title_en: Daily capture with ordinary Markdown files
sections.title_zh: 以普通 Markdown 文件做日常采集
sections.en: For an illustrative project journal, open the daily note, capture a decision and link it to a project with [[wiki links]]. The repository documents daily/, notes/, assets/ and audio-memos/ folders. Markdown files remain the source of truth, with local search and backlinks added by the app. Keep an inspectable folder backup and check attachments as well as text when moving a graph. This workflow was not executed.
sections.zh: 例如项目日志可从当天笔记开始，记录决策，再通过 [[wiki links]] 关联项目。仓库说明了 daily/、notes/、assets/ 和 audio-memos/ 文件夹。Markdown 文件是权威数据，应用在其上提供本地搜索与反向链接。迁移图谱时应保留可检查的文件夹备份，同时核对附件和文字。本次未实际运行该流程。

sections.title_en: Sync and AI are explicit external connections
sections.title_zh: 同步与 AI 是显式外部连接
sections.en: The repository says no Reflect account is required for Open. iCloud Drive can sync a graph, or Git/GitHub can provide a repository under your control. Optional AI uses user-provided provider keys, with calls sent to that provider; transcription is also separately configured. private: true is documented as excluding a note from AI and other external services, but this is not a claim that a file is excluded from every user-selected filesystem backup. Inspect the exact privacy model before relying on a flag.
sections.zh: 仓库说明 Open 无需 Reflect 账户。可用 iCloud Drive 同步图谱，也可通过 Git／GitHub 保存到自己控制的仓库。可选 AI 使用用户提供的服务商密钥，请求发送至该服务商；转录也需单独配置。文档把 private: true 说明为从 AI 和其他外部服务中排除该笔记，但这不能理解为该文件会从所有用户选择的文件系统备份中排除。依赖标记前应核对具体隐私模型。

sections.title_en: Open, mobile and Classic costs are distinct
sections.title_zh: Open、移动端与 Classic 费用不同
sections.en: The homepage gives free Mac use without a subscription and directs iPhone/iPad buyers to local App Store pricing, without a numeric price in the retrieved page. AI provider charges are separate. It also says paid Classic subscribers can claim a year of the mobile app, but claiming does not cancel Classic billing. The repository still describes iOS beta/TestFlight and experimental Windows/Linux builds. Confirm the distribution channel and offer eligibility rather than assuming these surfaces describe one uniform release.
sections.zh: 首页说明 Mac 无需订阅即可免费使用，iPhone／iPad 指向地区 App Store 定价，本次页面未显示数字价格。AI 服务商费用另计。页面还说明付费 Classic 订阅者可领取一年移动应用，但领取不会取消 Classic 账单。仓库仍描述 iOS 测试版／TestFlight，以及实验性 Windows／Linux 构建。应确认分发渠道与优惠资格，不能假定这些页面描述同一个统一发行版本。
